title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting — Part 1: Safety Requirements

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 16102 (Part 1) specifies safety requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting service having a supply voltage up to 250V. This standard is used for CRS (Compulsory Registration Scheme II) registration. LED lamps (bulbs) MUST be registered under CRS before sale in India.

clauses.title: Safety Tests and Requirements
clauses.text:
Safety requirements for LED lamps (IS 16102 Part 1):
- Marking: Rated voltage, rated wattage, rated frequency, manufacturer's name/trademark, model number
- Protection against electric shock: No accessible live parts at rated voltage
- Insulation resistance: ≥2 MΩ
- Electric strength: Withstand 1000V RMS for 1 minute
- Thermal test: Lamp shall operate safely at maximum ambient temperature
- Endurance test: 4000 hours of operation with no safety hazard
- EMC requirements per IS 9000 (CISPR 15 equivalent)
